_about: These are sha256(lowercase text)[:16] of terms the manual must not use. The names themselves are not stored in this repo. For this manual, only a retired product name is hashed; third-party host, format, and product names are allowed here by an approved exception. The build script also warns on a price-like token (a currency sign followed by a number). Add a hash with: python3 -c "import hashlib;print(hashlib.sha256('word'.lower().encode()).hexdigest()[:16])"
